app_fee.value: A $65 application fee plus a $2 processing fee, both non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: Submit Your Application and $65 Application Fee | Graduate applicants may be eligible for an application fee waiver of their $65 admission application fee (plus $2 processing fee).

fee_waiver.value: For international applicants, application fee waivers are only available if the program provides full funding packages (graduate assistantship) and the applicant attends a program information session; Fulbright and Gates Millennium Scholars also qualify.
fee_waiver.quote: International student eligibility: Application fee waivers are only available to international applicants if the program provides full funding packages, i.e. a graduate assistantship, and the applicant attends an information session offered by the program to which they’re applying.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School leaves the GRE to each program, so see the program records.
gre_general.quote: Many departments require essays or a statement of purpose, letters of recommendation, standardized test scores, e.g., GRE (not required by all programs)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum of 4.5 overall with 4 in reading and writing for tests taken on or after 21 January 2026 (the older scale required 80).
toefl_min.quote: Minimum overall of 4.5 with minimum subscores of 4 in reading and writing.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum of 6.5 overall, with 6.5 in reading and writing.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 6.5 overall score with minimum sub-scores of 6.5 in reading and writing

english_waiver.value: India is not on the list of countries whose degrees waive the English test, so an Indian degree needs a TOEFL, IELTS, PTE or Duolingo score. A degree from a US university would waive it.
english_waiver.quote: Completion of a bachelor's, master's or doctoral degree in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ghana, Ireland, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, United Kingdom, United States, or Zimbabwe

notes: Graduate School rules for all PhD applicants. The graduate directory lists 17 doctoral programs (the page text says 21); the Atlas records cover the STEM ones found there. Applied Physics is closed for 2027-28.
